From d20pfsrd.com: Nereid (3pp)

1/day—summon monster VI (water elementals only)

TACTICS

Nereids shy away from combat and flee at the first sign of conflict if possible. If forced into melee, a nereid uses her poison spray to blind an opponent.

Treasure standard

The nereid’s true form is that of a pool of water (a Medium water elemental). It can assume humanoid form at will (as a free action) and usually takes the form of a very beautiful female with long golden hair, pearly white skin, and green, almond-shaped eyes. Many sailors, seafarers, pirates, and other sea-goers have met their ends at the hands of the nereid. Their natural beauty lures men to their doom, for behind the beauty of the honeyed ones lies certain death for any creature that tries to steal a glance or kiss from the nereid.

From d20pfsrd.com: Nereid (Mythic)

hp 156 (12d6+114)
Fort +11 Ref +17 Will +14; second save
Defensive Abilities fortification (50%), transparency; DR 10/cold iron and epic; Immune cold, poison; SR 23
Weaknesses shawl

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 60 ft.
Melee touch +15 (poison)
Ranged spray +15 touch (poison) (range 30 ft.)
Special Attacks drowning kiss, liquefy, mythic power (5/day, surge 1d8), sea summoner, virulent venom
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 12th; concentration +19)

Liquefy (Su)

When a mythic nereid touches a creature, rather than using its poison it can transform the target (including all gear it carries) into liquid water (DC 23 Fort negates).

While in this form, the target is affected similarly to gaseous form, but cannot fly and instead has a swim speed of 10 feet.

This is a polymorph effect that lasts up to 1 minute, during which the target gains the water subtype and can breathe water. The target can attempt a new saving throw each round at the end of its turn. Once the target succeeds on 2 consecutive saves, it can reform its body and gear. A mythic nereid can extend the duration of this effect to 1 hour by expending one use of its mythic power when using this ability, or to 24 hours by expending two uses. If it extends the duration, the target can attempt a new save to recover only once per minute (if the duration is 1 hour) or once per hour hour (if the duration is 24 hours) rather than once per round. The save DC is Constitution-based.
